en.setting: Briar Clinic is a converted Victorian house on a quiet road, where the corridors dim after ten and the dispensary hums behind a coded door. The private ward holds four beds separated by curtains, and the night shift belongs to those who know the keycard system.
en.crime: Harold Stroud was found unresponsive in bed three of the private ward. His cardiac monitor had been silenced, his IV disconnected, and two drugs given within the same hour had stopped his heart.

suspects.name: Callum Dray
suspects.intro: The attending physician whose pen leaked in his pocket and whose car never left the car park until 5:30 AM.

suspects.name: Nurse Aldworth
suspects.intro: Administered the evening medication round, her hands trembling when she signed the chart.

suspects.name: Dr Parris
suspects.intro: Covered the night shift but would not enter the ward after the body was removed.

suspects.name: Owen Stroud
suspects.intro: The victim's nephew, sole insurance beneficiary, who visited twice that week and asked about the prognosis.

suspects.name: The Records Clerk
suspects.intro: Filed the negligence complaint three days before the death, her badge unsigned on the night in question.

suspects.name: Pharmacist Lin
suspects.intro: Dispensed both medications from the same tray, her vial count two short at shift end.

suspects.name: Solicitor Pike
suspects.intro: Represented the Stroud family in the negligence case and visited the clinic twice that week.

es.setting: La Clinica Briar es una casa victoriana reconvertida en una calle tranquila, donde los pasillos se oscurecen despues de las diez y el dispensario zumba detras de una puerta con codigo. La sala privada tiene cuatro camas separadas por cortinas, y el turno de noche pertenece a quienes conocen el sistema de tarjetas.
es.crime: Harold Stroud fue encontrado sin respuesta en la cama tres de la sala privada. Su monitor cardiaco habia sido silenciado, su via intravenosa desconectada, y dos medicamentos administrados en la misma hora habian detenido su corazon.

suspects.name: Callum Dray
suspects.intro: El medico tratante cuyo boligrafo goteo en su bolsillo y cuyo coche no salio del aparcamiento hasta las 5:30 AM.

suspects.name: Enfermera Aldworth
suspects.intro: Administro la ronda de medicacion vespertina, con las manos temblando al firmar la ficha.

suspects.name: Dr Parris
suspects.intro: Cubrio el turno de noche pero no quiso entrar en la sala despues de retirar el cuerpo.

suspects.name: Owen Stroud
suspects.intro: El sobrino de la victima, unico beneficiario del seguro, que visito dos veces esa semana y pregunto por el pronostico.

suspects.name: La Empleada de Registros
suspects.intro: Archivo la denuncia por negligencia tres dias antes de la muerte, su credencial sin firmar la noche en cuestion.

suspects.name: Farmaceutica Lin
suspects.intro: Dispenso ambos medicamentos de la misma bandeja, con dos viales de menos al final del turno.

suspects.name: Abogado Pike
suspects.intro: Represento a la familia Stroud en el caso de negligencia y visito la clinica dos veces esa semana.

fr.setting: La Clinique Briar est une maison victorienne reconvertie dans une rue tranquille, ou les couloirs s'assombrissent apres dix heures et la pharmacie bourdonne derriere une porte codee. Le service prive compte quatre lits separes par des rideaux, et le quart de nuit appartient a ceux qui connaissent le systeme de badges.
fr.crime: Harold Stroud a ete trouve inconscient dans le lit trois du service prive. Son moniteur cardiaque avait ete coupe, sa perfusion debranchee, et deux medicaments administres dans la meme heure avaient arrete son coeur.

suspects.name: Callum Dray
suspects.intro: Le medecin traitant dont le stylo a fui dans sa poche et dont la voiture n'a pas quitte le parking avant 5h30.

suspects.name: Infirmiere Aldworth
suspects.intro: A administre la tournee de medicaments du soir, les mains tremblantes en signant la fiche.

suspects.name: Dr Parris
suspects.intro: A assure le quart de nuit mais n'est pas entre dans le service apres le retrait du corps.

suspects.name: Owen Stroud
suspects.intro: Le neveu de la victime, seul beneficiaire de l'assurance, qui a visite deux fois cette semaine et demande le pronostic.

suspects.name: L'Employee des Archives
suspects.intro: A depose la plainte pour negligence trois jours avant le deces, son badge non signe la nuit en question.

suspects.name: Pharmacienne Lin
suspects.intro: A distribue les deux medicaments du meme plateau, avec deux flacons manquants en fin de service.

suspects.name: Avocat Pike
suspects.intro: Representait la famille Stroud dans l'affaire de negligence et a visite la clinique deux fois cette semaine.

physical_evidence.en: The medication chart bore Dray's signature at both administration times. The dispensary log showed his keycard entry at 22:47, and the interaction manual in his office lay open to the page he had marked in pencil. Two vials were missing from Pharmacist Lin's tray.
physical_evidence.es: La ficha de medicacion llevaba la firma de Dray en ambos horarios de administracion. El registro del dispensario mostraba su entrada con tarjeta a las 22:47, y el manual de interacciones en su oficina estaba abierto en la pagina que habia marcado a lapiz. Dos viales faltaban de la bandeja de la Farmaceutica Lin.
physical_evidence.fr: La fiche de medication portait la signature de Dray aux deux heures d'administration. Le registre de la pharmacie montrait son entree par badge a 22h47, et le manuel d'interactions dans son bureau etait ouvert a la page qu'il avait marquee au crayon. Deux flacons manquaient du plateau de la Pharmacienne Lin.

witness_testimony.en: Nurse Aldworth's hands trembled when she signed the chart, and she placed Dray in the corridor outside bed three at eleven. Owen Stroud confirmed his uncle feared the attending physician. The records clerk filed the negligence complaint three days before the death.
witness_testimony.es: Las manos de la Enfermera Aldworth temblaron al firmar la ficha, y situo a Dray en el pasillo frente a la cama tres a las once. Owen Stroud confirmo que su tio temia al medico tratante. La empleada de registros archivo la denuncia por negligencia tres dias antes de la muerte.
witness_testimony.fr: Les mains de l'Infirmiere Aldworth tremblaient en signant la fiche, et elle a place Dray dans le couloir devant le lit trois a onze heures. Owen Stroud a confirme que son oncle craignait le medecin traitant. L'employee des archives a depose la plainte pour negligence trois jours avant le deces.

financial_trail.en: Stroud's testimony would have ended Dray's career and triggered a malpractice settlement worth six figures. The insurance policy named Owen Stroud as sole beneficiary. Solicitor Pike's briefcase held the hearing schedule dated for Monday morning.
financial_trail.es: El testimonio de Stroud habria terminado la carrera de Dray y desencadenado un acuerdo por negligencia de seis cifras. La poliza de seguro nombraba a Owen Stroud como unico beneficiario. El maletin del Abogado Pike contenia el calendario de la audiencia programada para el lunes por la manana.
financial_trail.fr: Le temoignage de Stroud aurait mis fin a la carriere de Dray et declenche un reglement pour faute professionnelle a six chiffres. La police d'assurance designait Owen Stroud comme seul beneficiaire. La serviette de l'Avocat Pike contenait le calendrier de l'audience prevue pour lundi matin.

emotional_tells.en: Dray's pen leaked in his pocket the night of the death, and his car never left the car park until 5:30 AM. Dr Parris would not enter the ward after the body was removed. The cardiac monitor had been silenced by someone who knew the keycard system.
emotional_tells.es: El boligrafo de Dray goteo en su bolsillo la noche de la muerte, y su coche no salio del aparcamiento hasta las 5:30 AM. El Dr Parris no quiso entrar en la sala despues de retirar el cuerpo. El monitor cardiaco habia sido silenciado por alguien que conocia el sistema de tarjetas.
emotional_tells.fr: Le stylo de Dray a fui dans sa poche la nuit du deces, et sa voiture n'a pas quitte le parking avant 5h30. Le Dr Parris n'a pas voulu entrer dans le service apres le retrait du corps. Le moniteur cardiaque avait ete coupe par quelqu'un qui connaissait le systeme de badges.

cold_case_physical.en: The medication chart was rewritten on clean paper, and the dispensary inventory was corrected before the inquest. The cardiac monitor was reset to factory settings, and the two unaccounted vials were never found. Briar Clinic resumed its quiet rhythms behind coded doors.
cold_case_physical.es: La ficha de medicacion fue reescrita en papel limpio, y el inventario del dispensario fue corregido antes de la investigacion judicial. El monitor cardiaco fue restablecido a configuracion de fabrica, y los dos viales sin justificar nunca fueron encontrados. La Clinica Briar retomo sus ritmos tranquilos detras de puertas con codigo.
cold_case_physical.fr: La fiche de medication a ete reecrite sur du papier propre, et l'inventaire de la pharmacie corrige avant l'enquete. Le moniteur cardiaque a ete reinitialise aux parametres d'usine, et les deux flacons non comptabilises n'ont jamais ete retrouves. La Clinique Briar a repris ses rythmes tranquilles derriere des portes codees.

cold_case_financial.en: The negligence hearing was postponed indefinitely, and the malpractice file was sealed by the clinic's solicitors. Owen Stroud collected the insurance without challenge. Dray continued his rounds the next morning with his white coat pressed and his name still on the ward door.
cold_case_financial.es: La audiencia por negligencia fue aplazada indefinidamente, y el expediente por mala praxis fue sellado por los abogados de la clinica. Owen Stroud cobro el seguro sin cuestionamiento. Dray continuo sus rondas a la manana siguiente con su bata blanca planchada y su nombre aun en la puerta de la sala.
cold_case_financial.fr: L'audience pour negligence a ete reportee indefiniment, et le dossier de faute professionnelle a ete scelle par les avocats de la clinique. Owen Stroud a touche l'assurance sans contestation. Dray a continue ses tournees le lendemain matin avec sa blouse blanche repassee et son nom encore sur la porte du service.

all_strong.en: Callum Dray prescribed two drugs whose combined effect would stop a weakened heart, and he knew it. The medication chart bore his signature, the dispensary log his entry time, and the interaction manual lay open to the page he had marked in pencil. Harold Stroud was scheduled to testify against him on Monday. He never made it past Saturday night. The case was surgical in its precision and its cruelty.
all_strong.es: Callum Dray prescribio dos medicamentos cuyo efecto combinado detendria un corazon debilitado, y lo sabia. La ficha de medicacion llevaba su firma, el registro del dispensario su hora de entrada, y el manual de interacciones estaba abierto en la pagina que habia marcado a lapiz. Harold Stroud debia testificar contra el el lunes. No paso del sabado por la noche. El caso fue quirurgico en su precision y su crueldad.
all_strong.fr: Callum Dray a prescrit deux medicaments dont l'effet combine arreterait un coeur affaibli, et il le savait. La fiche de medication portait sa signature, le registre de la pharmacie son heure d'entree, et le manuel d'interactions etait ouvert a la page qu'il avait marquee au crayon. Harold Stroud devait temoigner contre lui lundi. Il n'a pas passe le samedi soir. L'affaire etait chirurgicale dans sa precision et sa cruaute.

who_strong_rest_weak.en: Dray's name hung over the ward like the smell of disinfectant — impossible to ignore, difficult to trace to its source. The dosage looked routine on paper, the interaction plausible as accident. Everyone knew he had the most to lose from Stroud's testimony, but the line between negligence and murder blurred under fluorescent light. The conviction came, but it tasted of reasonable doubt.
who_strong_rest_weak.es: El nombre de Dray pendia sobre la sala como el olor a desinfectante: imposible de ignorar, dificil de rastrear hasta su origen. La dosis parecia rutinaria sobre el papel, la interaccion plausible como accidente. Todos sabian que el tenia mas que perder con el testimonio de Stroud, pero la linea entre negligencia y asesinato se difuminaba bajo la luz fluorescente. La condena llego, pero sabia a duda razonable.
who_strong_rest_weak.fr: Le nom de Dray planait sur le service comme l'odeur de desinfectant — impossible a ignorer, difficile a remonter jusqu'a sa source. Le dosage semblait routinier sur le papier, l'interaction plausible comme accident. Tout le monde savait qu'il avait le plus a perdre du temoignage de Stroud, mais la frontiere entre negligence et meurtre s'estompait sous la lumiere fluorescente. La condamnation est tombee, mais elle avait un gout de doute raisonnable.

wrong_accusation.en: The wrong doctor was named, and Callum Dray continued his rounds the next morning with his white coat pressed and his pen freshly filled. The negligence hearing was quietly cancelled, the clinical notes rewritten on clean paper, and Harold Stroud's death recorded as cardiac failure of natural origin. The dispensary inventory was corrected before anyone thought to check it twice.
wrong_accusation.es: Se nombro al medico equivocado, y Callum Dray continuo sus rondas a la manana siguiente con su bata blanca planchada y su boligrafo recien cargado. La audiencia por negligencia fue cancelada discretamente, las notas clinicas reescritas en papel limpio, y la muerte de Harold Stroud registrada como insuficiencia cardiaca de origen natural. El inventario del dispensario fue corregido antes de que alguien pensara en revisarlo dos veces.
wrong_accusation.fr: Le mauvais medecin a ete designe, et Callum Dray a continue ses tournees le lendemain matin avec sa blouse blanche repassee et son stylo fraichement rempli. L'audience pour negligence a ete discretement annulee, les notes cliniques reecrites sur du papier propre, et la mort de Harold Stroud enregistree comme insuffisance cardiaque d'origine naturelle. L'inventaire de la pharmacie a ete corrige avant que quiconque ne pense a le verifier deux fois.

cold_case.en: The file on Harold Stroud was marked inconclusive and placed in a drawer that no one opened again. The negligence hearing was postponed indefinitely, the clinic resumed its quiet rhythms, and the attended observation hour returned to routine. Two vials remained unaccounted for in the dispensary log, and the cardiac alarm's silence was never explained. Briar Clinic kept its secrets behind coded doors.
cold_case.es: El expediente de Harold Stroud fue marcado como inconcluso y colocado en un cajon que nadie volvio a abrir. La audiencia por negligencia fue aplazada indefinidamente, la clinica retomo sus ritmos tranquilos, y la hora de observacion atendida volvio a la rutina. Dos viales quedaron sin justificar en el registro del dispensario, y el silencio de la alarma cardiaca nunca fue explicado. La Clinica Briar guardo sus secretos detras de puertas con codigo.
cold_case.fr: Le dossier de Harold Stroud a ete marque comme non concluant et place dans un tiroir que personne n'a rouvert. L'audience pour negligence a ete reportee indefiniment, la clinique a repris ses rythmes tranquilles, et l'heure d'observation est redevenue routine. Deux flacons sont restes non comptabilises dans le registre de la pharmacie, et le silence de l'alarme cardiaque n'a jamais ete explique. La Clinique Briar a garde ses secrets derriere des portes codees.

lucky_guess.en: Dray's name surfaced not from evidence but from the weight of suspicion. A physician with a pending review, a patient who would have ended his career — the arithmetic was simple, even if the proof was not. The jury convicted on instinct and inference, and the medication chart remained as ambiguous as the hour between rounds when no one was watching.
lucky_guess.es: El nombre de Dray surgio no de las pruebas sino del peso de la sospecha. Un medico con una revision pendiente, un paciente que habria terminado su carrera: la aritmetica era simple, aunque las pruebas no lo fueran. El jurado condeno por instinto e inferencia, y la ficha de medicacion permanecio tan ambigua como la hora entre rondas cuando nadie vigilaba.
lucky_guess.fr: Le nom de Dray est apparu non pas des preuves mais du poids des soupcons. Un medecin sous examen, un patient qui aurait mis fin a sa carriere — l'arithmetique etait simple, meme si les preuves ne l'etaient pas. Le jury a condamne par instinct et deduction, et la fiche de medication est restee aussi ambigue que l'heure entre les rondes ou personne ne surveillait.

expressions.suspect:callum_dray: Callum Dray checked his watch before answering any question. His white coat was pressed but the pen in his pocket had leaked.
expressions.event:dosage_interaction: Two medications given within the same hour produced a cardiac arrest. Each drug alone was within prescribed limits.
expressions.motive:negligence_testimony: Harold Stroud was scheduled to testify at a negligence hearing the following Monday. His statement named Callum Dray directly.
expressions.suspect:nurse_aldworth: Nurse Aldworth administered the evening round at nine. Her hands trembled when she signed the medication chart.
expressions.suspect:dr_parris: Dr Parris covered the night shift and checked the ward at midnight. His stethoscope was still around his neck at breakfast.
expressions.suspect:owen_stroud: Owen Stroud visited his uncle at seven and stayed for forty minutes. He asked the duty nurse about the prognosis twice.
expressions.suspect:records_clerk: The records clerk filed the complaint paperwork three days before the death. Her badge was unsigned on the night in question.
expressions.suspect:pharmacist_lin: Pharmacist Lin dispensed both medications from the same tray. Her inventory count at shift end was two vials short.
expressions.suspect:solicitor_pike: Solicitor Pike represented the Stroud family in the negligence case. He visited the clinic twice in the week before the death.
expressions.location:briar_clinic: Briar Clinic occupies a converted Victorian house on a quiet road. The night entrance is through a side door with a keycard lock.
expressions.location:private_ward: The private ward holds four beds separated by curtains. Bed three faces the window and the call button is on the left rail.
expressions.location:dispensary: The dispensary is behind a coded door at the end of the staff corridor. Two shelves hold cardiac medications in amber bottles.
expressions.location:staff_corridor: The staff corridor runs from the dispensary to the ward without passing reception. The lights dim automatically after ten.
expressions.location:records_office: The records office is locked after six but the keycard system logs all entries. The filing cabinet nearest the door holds active complaints.
expressions.location:consulting_room: Dray's consulting room contains a desk, two chairs, and a cabinet of clinical notes. The blinds were drawn on the night in question.
expressions.location:car_park: The car park holds twelve spaces behind the clinic. Dray's car was recorded entering at 22:14 and not leaving until 05:30.
expressions.location:waiting_room: The waiting room smells of disinfectant and old magazines. Owen Stroud signed the visitor log at 19:02.
expressions.object:medication_chart: The medication chart for bed three shows two entries at 21:00. Both dosages are individually within normal range.
expressions.object:syringe_tray: The syringe tray from the evening round holds two used syringes. One contains trace residue of a beta blocker.
expressions.object:drug_ledger: The dispensary ledger records all withdrawals by name and time. Dray's signature appears at 20:48, twelve minutes before the round.
expressions.object:interaction_manual: The drug interaction manual lies open on the dispensary shelf. The page for cardiac combinations is dog-eared and marked in pencil.
expressions.object:visitor_log: The visitor log shows Owen Stroud arriving at 19:02 and leaving at 19:41. No other visitors were recorded that evening.
expressions.object:autopsy_report: The autopsy found lethal levels of two drugs whose combined effect depresses cardiac rhythm. Individually, each was within safe limits.
expressions.object:prescription_carbon: The carbon copy of the prescription shows both drugs ordered on the same form. The handwriting matches Dray's clinical notes.
expressions.object:insurance_form: An insurance claim form sits in Owen Stroud's briefcase, partially completed. The beneficiary section lists Owen as sole recipient.
expressions.object:corridor_badge: A staff corridor badge was found on the waiting room floor. The name field is blank and the magnetic strip is deactivated.
expressions.object:ward_keycard: The ward keycard log shows three entries between 20:30 and 22:00. One entry has no matching staff assignment.
expressions.object:clinical_notes: Dray's clinical notes for Harold Stroud show a revised dosage recommendation dated two days before the death. The original page is missing.
expressions.object:lab_slip: A laboratory slip requesting cardiac enzyme levels was filed at 20:15. The results were never collected.
expressions.object:complaint_filing: The negligence complaint names Dray as the attending physician during a prior incident. The hearing date is circled in red.
expressions.emotion:professional_calm: His voice did not change when the death was confirmed. He asked for the chart and read it without sitting down.
expressions.emotion:shaking_hands: Her hands shook when she held the chart for the inspector. She set it on the desk rather than hand it across.
expressions.emotion:clipped_answers: Every response was one sentence or fewer. He did not volunteer any detail beyond what was directly asked.
expressions.emotion:avoided_ward: Dr Parris did not enter the private ward after the body was removed. He stood in the corridor and looked at the floor.
expressions.emotion:rehearsed_grief: Owen Stroud's eulogy was word-perfect and delivered without pause. He had not been told the cause of death.
expressions.emotion:rigid_composure: She answered each question with the same even tone. Her eyes moved to the dispensary door and back.
expressions.modifier:dosage_doubled: The combined effect of both drugs doubled the suppression of cardiac rhythm. Any physician trained in cardiology would know this.
expressions.modifier:chart_amended: The medication chart shows a correction in different ink. The original dosage has been overwritten with a lower figure.
expressions.modifier:badge_unsigned: The corridor badge found in the waiting room has no name or photograph. The magnetic strip was never activated.
expressions.modifier:insulin_combined: The second drug was an insulin analogue given for blood sugar management. Its cardiac side effects are listed on page forty-seven of the manual.
expressions.modifier:corridor_dim: The staff corridor lights dim to half brightness after ten. The motion sensor near the dispensary door was offline.
expressions.modifier:lock_overridden: The ward door lock was overridden by a master keycard at 20:51. The master card is assigned to senior physicians only.
expressions.modifier:handwriting_match: The revised clinical notes match Dray's handwriting in slope and pressure. The ink is from a different pen than the rest of the file.
expressions.modifier:fresh_notation: A pencil notation in the drug interaction manual was made recently. The graphite has not yet dulled.
expressions.modifier:vial_count_short: The dispensary inventory at shift end was two vials short of the morning count. No breakage was reported.
expressions.modifier:filing_date_wrong: The complaint filing is dated three days before the death. The postmark on the envelope shows it arrived five days earlier.
expressions.action:chart_signed: The medication chart was signed by Nurse Aldworth at 21:00 and countersigned by Dray at 21:03. Both signatures are in the same ink.
expressions.action:dispensary_visited: The dispensary keycard log shows Dray entered at 20:48 and exited at 20:56. The standard withdrawal takes under two minutes.
expressions.action:records_accessed: The records office keycard shows an entry at 23:10 from a master card. No staff member was scheduled to access records after hours.
expressions.action:injection_given: Two injections were administered during the evening medication round. The second was given eleven minutes after the first.
expressions.action:alarm_delayed: The cardiac alarm sounded at 05:12 but the ward orderly found the body already cold. The alarm delay suggests it was silenced and re-armed.
expressions.action:notes_rewritten: The clinical notes for Harold Stroud were rewritten on new paper and re-filed. The original notes have not been found.
expressions.action:family_visited: Owen Stroud visited his uncle three times in the week before the death. Each visit lasted under forty-five minutes.
expressions.action:complaint_filed: The negligence complaint was filed by Solicitor Pike on behalf of Harold Stroud. It referenced a prior surgical error by Dray.
expressions.action:lab_ordered: A laboratory panel was ordered for Harold Stroud at 20:15. The order slip bears Dray's initials.
expressions.time:attended_observation: The attended observation hour runs from 21:00 to 22:00. During this period a nurse checks vitals every fifteen minutes.
expressions.time:night_round: The night round begins at midnight and covers all four beds. Dr Parris recorded normal readings at 00:15.
expressions.time:shift_handover: The shift handover occurs at 06:00. Nurse Aldworth's notes from the previous shift were incomplete.
expressions.time:dawn_alarm: The cardiac alarm triggered at 05:12. The responding orderly found the patient unresponsive and cold to the touch.
expressions.time:hearing_scheduled: The negligence hearing was scheduled for Monday the fourteenth. Harold Stroud was the sole complainant witness.
expressions.motive:malpractice_cover: If Stroud testified, Dray's surgical error from the previous year would become public record. His licence review was already pending.
expressions.motive:insurance_claim: Owen Stroud stood to receive a substantial insurance payout upon his uncle's death. The policy had been updated six months earlier.
expressions.motive:career_ruin: A successful negligence ruling would end Dray's career in private practice. No clinic would insure a physician with a public finding.
expressions.motive:family_grudge: Owen Stroud had quarrelled with his uncle over the estate. Harold had threatened to change the insurance beneficiary.
expressions.motive:prior_complaint: A prior complaint against Dray had been settled privately two years earlier. The terms included a non-disclosure clause.
expressions.witness:night_porter: The night porter saw Dray's car enter the car park at 22:14. He did not see anyone else arrive after that.
expressions.witness:ward_orderly: The ward orderly found Harold Stroud unresponsive at 05:12. He described the body as cold and the bedside glass as untouched.
expressions.witness:lab_assistant: The lab assistant received the enzyme order at 20:15 but the sample never arrived. She filed the slip in the incomplete tray.
expressions.witness:duty_nurse: The duty nurse recorded normal vitals at 21:15 and 21:30. She did not check again until the alarm sounded.
expressions.witness:ambulance_driver: The ambulance was called at 05:18 and arrived at 05:31. The driver noted that the clinic front door was already propped open.
expressions.event:harold_stroud_discovered: Harold Stroud was found unresponsive in bed three of the private ward. The cardiac monitor had been silenced and the IV line was disconnected.
expressions.event:medication_round: The evening medication round was completed at 21:11. Two injections were logged for bed three, both within prescribed parameters.
